summary.text: David Reid is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 28, which covers part of Loudoun County.
David Reid has been a member since 2018.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, David Reid was born in Lexington, Virginia, in 1962.
David Reid studied at Northeastern Oklahoma State University (B.A., 1984) and the Joint Military Intelligence College (master's, 2002).
David Reid's listed occupation is retired.
The profile says David Reid served in the U.S. Naval Reserve as a Commander from 1988 to 2011.
David Reid's listed memberships and affiliations include Arcola United Methodist Church, NAACP Loudoun County, and the Loudoun County Democratic Committee.
The profile lists Barbara E. Reid as David Reid's spouse.

The House profile lists David Reid's committee assignments as Transportation (Vice Chair), Privileges and Elections, and Appropriations, and David Reid chairs the Highway Safety and Policy subcommittee of Transportation and the Transportation and Public Safety subcommittee of Appropriations.
